item.text:
**3B.7 Research Note: Ali Khamenei (2024)**

**Bottom line:** I found no convincing evidence that Khamenei protected women, children, minorities, or other vulnerable groups from targeted violence, persecution, displacement, or systematic neglect in 2024. The evidence is overwhelmingly negative: coercive veiling enforcement, persecution of Baha’is, harsh treatment of ethnic minorities, and executions of child offenders. The only meaningful positive signal is a late-2024 pause in implementation of the stricter hijab law, which is limited and temporary.

|---|---|---:|---|---|---|
| [Iran: Draconian campaign to enforce compulsory veiling laws through surveillance and mass car confiscations](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/) | Amnesty International | 2024-03-06 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/03/iran-draconian-campaign-to-enforce-compulsory-veiling-laws-through-surveillance-and-mass-car-confiscations/ | Amnesty documented widespread surveillance, mass police checks, car confiscations, prosecutions, flogging, and “morality” classes aimed at women and girls defying veiling rules. This is direct evidence against protection of vulnerable groups. | 3B.7; also 3B.5, 3B.2, 3B.6 |
| [Iran: Women and Girls Facing Violent Crackdown](https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/mde13/8029/2024/en/) | Amnesty International | 2024-05-07 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/documents/mde13/8029/2024/en/ | Amnesty said security forces intensified compulsory-veiling enforcement through surveillance, beatings, sexual violence, electric shocks, arbitrary arrest, and detention. This is strong evidence of targeted violence against women and girls rather than their protection. | 3B.7; also 3B.5, 3B.2, 3B.1 |
| [Iran: New compulsory veiling law intensifies oppression of women and girls](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/) | Amnesty International | 2024-12-10 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/12/iran-new-compulsory-veiling-law-intensifies-oppression-of-women-and-girls/ | The new law imposed death-penalty exposure, flogging, prison terms, travel bans, and impunity for vigilantes attacking women and girls. That is explicit codification of coercion, not protection. | 3B.7; also 3B.5, 3B.2, 3B.4 |
| [The Boot on My Neck: Iranian Authorities’ Crime of Persecution Against Baha’is in Iran](https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/04/01/boot-my-neck/iranian-authorities-crime-persecution-against-bahais-iran) | Human Rights Watch | 2024-04-01 | https://www.hrw.org/report/2024/04/01/boot-my-neck/iranian-authorities-crime-persecution-against-bahais-iran | HRW documented that Iranian authorities used national-security pretexts to raid, arrest, and prosecute Baha’is based on faith identity. This is direct evidence of failure to protect a religious minority from targeted persecution. | 3B.7; also 3B.2, 3B.4, 3B.1 |
| [Execution of Ethnic Minorities in Iran in 2024](https://iranhr.net/en/articles/7376/) | Iran Human Rights | 2025-02-26 | https://iranhr.net/en/articles/7376/ | The report says ethnic minorities, especially Kurds and Baloch, were disproportionately executed in 2024, often with little or no public announcement. That supports a pattern of targeted violence and discriminatory punishment, not protection. | 3B.7; also 3B.1, 3B.2 |
| [Iran: Executions of protester with mental disability and Kurdish man mark plunge into new realms of cruelty](https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/01/iran-executions-of-protester-with-mental-disability-and-kurdish-man-mark-plunge-into-new-realms-of-cruelty/) | Amnesty International | 2024-01-24 | https://www.amnesty.org/en/latest/news/2024/01/iran-executions-of-protester-with-mental-disability-and-kurdish-man-mark-plunge-into-new-realms-of-cruelty/ | Amnesty said Iran executed a protester with a mental disability and a Kurdish Sunni man after secretive, grossly unfair processes. This is direct evidence against protection of vulnerable persons, including minorities and people with disabilities. | 3B.7; also 3B.1, 3B.2 |
| [Iran: 853 people executed last year after surge in use of death penalty in drugs cases](https://www.amnesty.org.uk/latest/iran-853-people-executed-last-year-after-surge-use-death-penalty-drugs-cases/) | Amnesty International UK | 2024-04-04 | https://www.amnesty.org.uk/latest/iran-853-people-executed-last-year-after-surge-use-death-penalty-drugs-cases/ | Amnesty highlighted executions of child offenders and said Iran continued to sentence and execute people for crimes committed under 18 through flawed juvenile procedures. That is evidence against protection of children. | 3B.7; also 3B.1, 3B.2 |
| [Iran pauses implementation of stricter hijab law for women](https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women) | Euronews / AP | 2024-12-18 | https://www.euronews.com/2024/12/18/iran-pauses-implementation-of-stricter-hijab-law-for-women | Senior bodies paused implementation of the stricter hijab law for the time being, which is the clearest limited positive signal I found. It is a narrow procedural retreat, not durable protection from targeted violence. | 3B.7; also 3B.5 |

**Search gap**
- I found no reliable 2024 evidence that Khamenei built a real protection regime for vulnerable groups.
- I also found no credible evidence of systematic protection from displacement or from intergroup/religious/ethnic violence.
- The closest positive signal is the temporary pause in the stricter hijab law’s implementation, but the broader record still shows coercion, harassment, and discriminatory punishment.
